section.content: 机器学习装置包含：处理器，其处理数据样本；以及存储装置，其储存处理的结果。处理器根据多个学习数据库制作多个识别器。多个学习数据库分别储存多个学习数据样本。处理器制作多个识别器各自的识别性能的评价结果，根据评价结果，将多个学习数据库中的一个学习数据库以及根据所述一个学习数据库生成的识别器决定为要使用的学习数据库以及识别器。

The machine learning device includes: a processor that processes data samples; and a storage device that stores a result of the processing. The processor creates a plurality of recognizers from the plurality of learning databases. The plurality of learning databases respectively store a plurality of learning data samples. The processor generates an evaluation result of the recognition performance of each of the plurality of recognizers, and determines one of the plurality of learning databases and the recognizer generated from the one learning database as the learning database and the recognizer to be used, based on the evaluation result.

Machine learning deviceReference-based fetching

The present application claims priority of japanese application No. 2019-181165, filed on 1/10/2019, and is incorporated by reference for its content.

Technical Field

The present invention relates to machine learning, and is applicable to, for example, an image processing technique using machine learning for detecting a specific object (for example, a cancer cell, a bubble on a liquid surface, or the like) included in a captured image.

Background

In recent years, studies have been made on image recognition techniques using machine learning and the like. By using Deep Learning or the like, the detection accuracy of an object in an image is improved. For example, patent document 1 proposes a technique for developing a recognizer for detecting an object in an image. In patent document 1, a plurality of learning image data sets are set to perform machine learning, and parameters of a neural network are calculated.

Documents of the prior art

Patent document

Patent document 1: japanese patent laid-open publication No. 2016-143351

Disclosure of Invention

Problems to be solved by the invention

However, as in patent document 1, even if the learning image is divided into a plurality of image groups and the parameters are obtained by relearning, there is a case where an image that does not contribute to improvement of the recognition accuracy of the recognizer is included in the image groups, and the recognition accuracy of the recognizer is not necessarily improved. In addition, in patent document 1, it is not possible to create a learning image database that can continuously improve the recognition accuracy of the recognizer.

Means for solving the problems

A machine learning device according to an aspect of the present invention includes: a processor that processes data samples; and a storage device that stores a result of the processing. The processor creates a plurality of discriminators from a plurality of learning databases each storing a plurality of learning data samples, creates an evaluation result of the recognition performance of each of the plurality of discriminators, and determines one of the plurality of learning databases and a discriminator generated from the one learning database as a learning database and a discriminator to be used, based on the evaluation result.

Further features of the present invention will be apparent from the description and drawings of the present specification. The embodiments of the present invention are realized by the combination of elements and various elements, the following detailed description, and the embodiments of the appended claims. The description of the present specification is merely exemplary in nature and should not be construed as limiting the scope of the invention in any way.

Effects of the invention

According to an aspect of the present invention, an appropriate learning database and an identifier can be created and used.

Detailed Description

In one embodiment, a plurality of discriminators are created by performing machine learning using each image of a learning image database, evaluation results are obtained by evaluating the created discriminators, and the possibility of updating the discriminators and the learning image database is controlled by determining the evaluation results. Thus, a machine learning device and a method thereof are provided for creating a learning image database composed of a recognizer capable of recognizing an object (for example, a tissue, a cell, or the like) in an image with high accuracy and an image contributing to improvement in continuous recognition accuracy of the recognizer.

Hereinafter, embodiments of the present invention will be described with reference to the drawings. In the drawings, functionally identical elements may be denoted by the same reference numerals. Further, the drawings show specific embodiments and mounting examples following the principle of the present invention, but these are for understanding the present invention and are not intended to be construed restrictively.

In the present embodiment, a person skilled in the art has described the present invention in sufficient detail to practice the present invention, but it is to be understood that other mounting and forms are possible, and that structural and structural changes and substitutions of various elements can be made without departing from the scope and spirit of the technical idea of the present invention. Therefore, the following description is not to be construed as being limited thereto.

As will be described later, the embodiments of the present invention may be installed by software running on a general-purpose computer, or may be installed by dedicated hardware or a combination of software and hardware. In the following, each process in the embodiment of the present invention will be described with "each processing unit (e.g., learning unit or the like) as a program" as a subject (action subject), but since a process specified by a processor (CPU or the like) executing a program is performed while using a memory and a communication port (communication control device), a description may be made with a processor as a subject.

(1) First embodiment

< functional Structure of machine learning device >

Fig. 1 is a block diagram showing a functional configuration of a machine learning device according to a first embodiment. The machine learning device 1 includes: the image processing apparatus includes an input unit 10, a learning unit 11, an adaptability evaluation unit 12, an update determination unit 13, a drawing unit 14, a control unit 91, a learning image Database (DB) (determination) 100, a learning image DB (before determination + determination) 101, an evaluation image 102, and a memory 90. The machine learning device 1 may be installed in an image acquisition device such as an image diagnosis support device, or may be installed in a server connected to the image acquisition device via a network as described later (third to fourth embodiments).

The input unit 10, the learning unit 11, the adaptability evaluation unit 12, the update determination unit 13, and the drawing unit 14 in the machine learning device 1 may be implemented by a program or a processor that executes a program, or may be implemented by hardware modules.

The image data is input to the input unit 10. For example, the input unit 10 may acquire encoded still image data in the form of JPG, Jpeg2000, PNG, BMP, or the like, which is captured at predetermined time intervals by imaging means such as a camera (not shown in fig. 1) built in the image acquisition apparatus, as an input image.

The input unit 10 may extract still image data of frames at predetermined intervals from moving image data of motion jpeg, MPEG, h.264, HD/SDI format, or the like, and acquire the image as an input image. The input unit 10 can acquire an input image from an imaging unit via a bus, a network, or the like. The input section 10 can acquire an image already stored in a detachable recording medium as an input image. The image input from the input section 10 is stored as a learning image (before determination) in the learning image DB (before determination + before determination) 101.

The learning image DB (determination) 100 stores a plurality of combinations of images for learning, determined images, and positive tabs. Positive de-labels corresponding to the respective images are determined. The learning image (before specification) is composed of a plurality of combinations of the learning image, the image before specification, and the positive solution label. The positive tags corresponding to the respective images can be changed.

The learning unit 11 performs machine learning to recognize an image of a specific object in the input image as the specific object, for example, to recognize an image of a normal tissue or cell as a normal tissue or cell, and to recognize an image of an abnormal tissue or cell in the input image as an abnormal tissue or cell. The learning unit 11 creates a recognizer CA (a parameter (filter coefficient, offset value, etc.) necessary for recognition) from the learning image DB (determination) 100. The learning unit 11 creates the recognizer CB based on the learning image DB (before determination + before determination) 101 obtained by adding the learning image (before determination) input from the input unit 10 to the learning image DB (before determination) 100.

The suitability evaluation unit 12 calculates the recognition results and recognition values of the recognizers CA and CB using the evaluation image 102. The update determination unit 13 controls whether or not the identifier CA and the learning image DB (determination) 100 can be updated, using the identification results and the identification values of the identifiers CA and CB obtained by the adaptability evaluation unit 12. The update determination unit 13 also determines Ave, which will be described later, obtained by the adaptability evaluation unit 12dr1、Avedr2Each MdrNThe number of updates of the identifier CA and the learning image DB (determination) determined by the update determination unit 13, and the updated Avedr1The information such as the transition of (c) is stored in the memory 90.

The control unit 91 is realized by a processor that executes a program, for example, and is connected to each element in the machine learning device 1. The components of the machine learning device 1 operate as described above either autonomously or in response to an instruction from the control unit 91.

As described above, in the machine learning device 1 of the present embodiment, the learning unit 11 performs machine learning, generates the recognizer CA from the learning image DB (specification) 100, and creates the recognizer CB from the learning image DB (specification + before specification) 101 obtained by adding the learning image (before specification) input from the input unit 10 to the learning image DB (specification) 100. The suitability evaluation unit 12 calculates the recognition results and recognition values of the recognizers CA and CB using the evaluation image 102. The update determination unit 13 controls whether or not the identifier CA and the learning image DB (determination) 100 can be updated, using the identification results and the identification values of the identifiers CA and CB obtained by the adaptability evaluation unit 12.

< hardware configuration of machine learning apparatus >

Fig. 2A is a diagram showing an example of the hardware configuration of the machine learning device 1 according to the first embodiment. The machine learning device 1 includes: a CPU (processor) 201 that executes various programs, a memory 202 (main storage device) that stores various programs, and an auxiliary storage device 203 (corresponding to the memory 90) that stores various data. The machine learning device 1 further includes: output means 204 for outputting the recognition result, the recognizer, and the update possibility result of the learning image DB (determination) 100; an input device 205 for inputting instructions, images, and the like of a user; and a communication device 206 for communicating with other apparatuses. These components in the machine learning device 1 are connected to each other via a bus 207.

The CPU201 reads various programs from the memory 202 as necessary and executes them. The memory 202 stores an input unit 10, a learning unit 11, an adaptability evaluation unit 12, an update determination unit 13, and a drawing unit 14 as programs.

The auxiliary storage device 203 stores the learning image (before the determination), the parameters of the discriminators CA and CB generated by the learning unit 11, the recognition result and the recognition value generated by the suitability evaluation unit 12, and the update result determined by the update determination unit 13. The auxiliary storage device 203 also stores a learning image DB (determination) 100, a learning image DB (before determination + determination) 101, position information for drawing the detection frame generated by the drawing unit 14, and the like. The memory 202, the secondary storage device 203, or a combination thereof is a storage device.

The output device 204 includes a display, a printer, a speaker, and the like. For example, the output device 204 is a display device, and displays the data generated by the drawing unit 14 on a screen. The input device 205 includes devices such as a keyboard, a mouse, and a microphone. The instruction of the user (including the determination of the learning image (before determination) input) is input to the machine learning device 1 through the input device 205.

The communication device 206 is not necessarily required in the machine learning apparatus 1, and when the communication device is included in a personal computer or the like connected to the image acquisition apparatus, the machine learning apparatus 1 may not hold the communication device 206. The communication device 206 receives data (including an image) transmitted from another device (for example, a server) connected via a network, for example, and stores the data in the auxiliary storage device 203.

The machine learning device according to the present embodiment performs machine learning using images of a learning image database to create a plurality of discriminators, and evaluates the created plurality of discriminators to obtain evaluation results. The machine learning device determines the evaluation result and controls whether or not the identifier and the learning image database are updated, thereby making it possible to create a learning image database including an identifier capable of identifying an object (for example, a tissue, a cell, or the like) in an image with higher accuracy and an image contributing to improvement in the continuous identification accuracy of the identifier.

< Structure and operation of Each component >

Hereinafter, the structure and operation of each element will be described in detail.

(i) Learning unit 11

(i-ii) local recognition unit 112

As shown in fig. 5, the local recognition unit 112 calculates a value of object similarity (e.g., lesion similarity) for each local region by using the feature amount FAi of the feature extractor FEA obtained by the feature extraction unit 111 and a nonlinear function NF (e.g., sigmoid function) according to formula 2. The local recognition unit 112 determines whether or not the object in the input image Ai is an object to be detected (for example, a normal cell, an abnormal cell, or the like) based on the calculated value.

The learning unit 11 learns the feature amount of each object by using an existing machine learning technique, so that the entire recognition unit 113 recognizes each object in the input image as each object by using the local recognition value (for example, recognizes normal tissue and normal cells as normal tissue and normal cells, and recognizes abnormal tissue and abnormal cells as abnormal tissue and abnormal cells), and obtains the coefficient of the filter W and the offset value B. For example, a conditional Neural Network may be used as a technique of machine learning.

As shown in fig. 7, the learning unit 11 calculates the feature amount FAi of the input image Ai by the formula 1 using the input image Ai (for example, a pathological image) by machine learning in advance. Next, the learning unit 11 obtains the local recognition value LS from the feature value FAi by equation 2. The learning unit 11 calculates parameters of expressions 1 to 3 using the base recognition value BS obtained from the local recognition value LS, and determines an image of each target object as each target object (for example, determines abnormal tissue and abnormal cells as abnormal tissue and abnormal cells, and determines normal tissue and normal cells as normal tissue and normal cells).

The learning unit 11 repeatedly performs the processing of the feature extraction unit 111, the local recognition unit 112, and the whole recognition unit 113 using a plurality of learning images of the learning image DB (identification) 100 to obtain parameters (such as the filter coefficient wj, the coefficient of the filter W, and the offset values bi and B) shown in equations 1, 2, and 3.

The learning unit 11 creates an identifier CA including a feature extractor for calculating a feature amount of an input image from the input image, a local identifier for obtaining a local identification value, and a local identifier for obtaining a local identification value. Similarly, the learning unit 11 obtains parameters (such as the filter coefficient wj, the coefficient of the filter W, and the offset values bi and B) shown in equations 1, 2, and 3 using a plurality of learning images of the learning image DB (before determination + before determination) 101, and creates the identifier CB. The learning unit 11 stores the obtained parameters (the filter coefficient wj, the coefficient of the filter W, the offset values bi and B, and the like) in the memory 90.

For example, the learning unit 11 adjusts the balance of the number of images of the recognition type of each of the learning image DB (determination) 100 and the learning image DB (before determination + determination) 101, and creates the recognizers CA and CB. For example, the learning section 11 adjusts the number of images in the learning image DB (determination) 100 and the learning image DB (before determination + determination) 101, respectively, so that the difference in the number of images between the recognition types is smaller than a predetermined threshold value. This enables more appropriate evaluation.

< processing procedure of machine learning apparatus >

Fig. 9 is a flowchart for explaining the operation of the learning unit 11 of the machine learning device 1 according to the first embodiment. In the following, the learning unit 11 is described as the main operation unit, but instead the CPU201 may be the main operation unit, and the CPU201 may execute each processing unit as a program.

(i) Step 901

The input unit 10 receives an input image Ai for learning and outputs the input image Ai to the learning unit 11.

(ii) Step 902

The learning unit 11 obtains the feature amount of an object (for example, tissue, cell, or the like) in the input image Ai by machine learning using a filter according to the above formula 1, and creates a feature extractor FEA. The learning unit 11 obtains a filter coefficient wj and an offset value bi for the feature value FAi.

(iii) Step 903

The learning unit 11 obtains the local recognition value LS from the feature value FAi according to the formula 2 by machine learning, calculates the value of the object similarity (e.g., lesion similarity) for each local region, and obtains each parameter (the coefficient of the filter W, the offset value B, etc.) of the formula 2 for obtaining the local recognition value to determine whether or not the object in the input image Ai is an object to be detected (e.g., a normal cell, an abnormal cell, etc.).

(iv) Step 904

The learning unit 11 determines each parameter (such as a coefficient of the filter W and an offset value B) of equation 3 by machine learning, using the base recognition value BS determined from the local recognition value LS, to determine an image of each target object as each target object (for example, determines abnormal tissue and abnormal cells as abnormal tissue and abnormal cells, and determines normal tissue and normal cells as normal tissue and normal cells).

(v) Step 905

The learning unit 11 stores the parameters (filter coefficient wj, coefficient of the filter W, offset values bi and B, etc.) of equations 1, 2 and 3 in the memory 90.

As described above, even when the learning image database includes an image that does not contribute to improvement of the recognition accuracy of the recognizer, the machine learning device automatically determines an image that contributes to improvement of the recognition accuracy of the recognizer, and controls whether or not the recognizer and the learning image database are updatable based on the determination result. More specifically, the machine learning device performs machine learning using each image of a plurality of learning image databases to create a plurality of discriminators, and evaluates the created plurality of discriminators to obtain an evaluation result. The machine learning device determines a plurality of evaluation results, controls whether or not the identifier and the learning image database are updatable, and determines the learning image database and the identifier to be used. This makes it possible to create a learning image database including a recognizer capable of recognizing an object (for example, a tissue, a cell, or the like) in an image with high accuracy and an image contributing to improvement in the continuous recognition accuracy of the recognizer.
